verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own announcement documents both halves of the story. Scheduled send lets you write a message, set a future send time with a natural-language scheduler, and move on. Undo send reverts an accidentally sent message back to a draft. Missing for 10: documentation of the undo grace-window duration or configurability, and independent or hands-on corroboration of either feature.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule an email to send later and undo a send within a grace window

citations.quote: Scheduled send gives you the ability to send an email at a future time. All you have to do is write a message, set a send time, and then move on to your next task.
Shortwave's scheduler uses the power of natural language to give you maximum control over when your email gets sent.
Undo send staves off the panic you feel when you accidentally send a message that wasn't ready by allowing you to revert a sent message back to a draft.
